title: Kosice Wolves claim 1Liga title
description: Kosice Wolves celebrated 1Liga title. They outscored Academic Zilina 103-85 in the championship game today. Adam Moncek (190-G-2000) tallied 28 points, 11 rebounds and 11 assists to lead the champions. Kosice Wolves established a 47-36 halftime lead. They poured in 56 points in the second half and rallied to the win. Dmytro Sokolovskyi (190-PG-2004) finished with 26 points for the winners. Simon Duris (183-PG-1998) answered with 27 points, 11 assists and 9 rebounds for Academic Zilina.
